blocks.text: Network load balancing network traffic ko sambhalne ke liye istemal hoti hai. Yeh kaam ko kai servers ya links mein baant deti hai. Is se koi ek device had se zyada bojh (overload) tale nahi aata. Load balancing network ki raftar aur reliability (bharosa) behtar karti hai. Yeh bare networks aur data centers mein istemal hoti hai. Sahi load balancing performance hamwaar rakhti hai. Yeh networks ko zyada users sambhalne mein madad deti hai.

Load balancing network ki raftar aur jawab ka waqt (response time) behtar karti hai. Yeh server ke fail hone ka khatra kam karti hai. Agar ek server fail ho jaye to baqi kaam karte rehte hain. Is se user ka tajurba behtar hota hai. Load balancing zyada traffic aasani se sambhalne mein madad deti hai. Yeh network ki reliability aur availability (har waqt dastiyab rehna) barhati hai.

Load balancing ke mukhtalif tareeqe hain. Round Robin tareeqa requests bari bari (ek ek kar ke) servers ko bhejta hai: 1, 2, 3, phir 1, 2, 3. Least Connection tareeqa traffic kam masroof servers ko bhejta hai. IP Hash tareeqa user ke IP address se tay karta hai ke traffic kis server ko jaye. Yeh tareeqe network ka bojh barabar karte hain. Saada tareeqe lagana aasan hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar users ki requests aik load balancer tak aati hain, jo inhein teer ke zariye server 1, server 2 aur server 3 mein baant deta hai.
blocks.caption: Teen servers mein load balancing (asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa load balancing tareeqa un servers ke liye munasib hoga jo aksar bohat mukhtalif muddat ke liye masroof rehte hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Least Connection, kyunke yeh sirf bari bari dene ke bajaye dekhta hai ke har server is waqt kitna masroof hai, is liye lambe kaamon mein phansa server mazeed kaam nahi pata.

items: Load balancing traffic ko kai servers ya links mein baant'ti hai.
Fawaid: tez raftar, server fail ho to bhi kaam jari, zyada users, zyada bharosa.
Tareeqe: Round Robin (bari bari), Least Connection (kam masroof), IP Hash (IP address se).
